articles.title: Buying a home in Noida? UP RERA notifies new IFMS rules — Here's all you need to know

articles.title: 13-year shift in mutual fund AUM mix: Why retail and HNI share rose while corporate ownership declined
articles.summary: Mutual fund ownership in India has shifted sharply over the past 13 years. The corporate share of AUM fell from 50.1% in 2013 to 36.7% in 2026, while retail and HNI investors’ combined share rose from 43.5% to 62.3%.

articles.title: HSBC India offers zero forex markup on all credit cards — What this feature means for your travels abroad, explained
articles.summary: HSBC India is offering customers zero forex markup on all of its credit cards. We take a look at what this charge is, how it is calculated and explain what this could mean for the cost of your travels abroad.

articles.title: Flexi-cap funds received 3x more inflows than multi-caps in FY26 despite similar returns: What should investors do?
articles.summary: Flexi-cap and multi-cap funds both invest across large-, mid- and small-caps, but their mandates differ. Despite similar returns, FY26 saw a sharp divergence in inflows. What is driving investor preference, and should investors rethink their multi-cap holdings?

articles.title: Trump used direct indexing to save on taxes. What is the strategy, how does it work and should you follow it too?

articles.title: Healthcare beats Nifty 50: Should investors shift from broader-market index funds to growth sectors?
articles.summary: Healthcare has outperformed the Nifty 50 across several periods, with the BSE Healthcare TRI delivering a 22.7% CAGR over seven years. But does this mean investors should look beyond their broad-market index funds and opt for sectoral funds?

articles.title: Insurance industry grew 9% in FY26, health and motor fastest growing segments, finds BCG report
articles.summary: India's general insurance industry grew 9% in FY26 to ₹336,000 crore, with health and motor being the fastest growing segments due to pick up from GST rate rationalisation, according to a BCG report.

articles.title: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana: ₹2,500 aid cannot be spent on tobacco, gambling and...; here's what’s banned?
articles.summary: The Delhi Lakshmi Yojana provides ₹2,500 monthly to eligible women from low-income families, effective August 1. Beneficiaries face strict eligibility checks and spending restrictions.

articles.title: Advance tax under Income Tax Act, 2025: Who needs to pay, deadlines and how to calculate it
articles.summary: Advance tax helps taxpayers spread their income tax payments throughout the year instead of paying a lump sum later. The Income Tax Act, 2025, introduces rules from Tax Year 2026–27. Here’s who needs to pay, key deadlines, and how to calculate it.

articles.title: Oil prices could fall to $60: Will petrol and diesel get cheaper for the common man?
articles.summary: Mark Matthews of Julius Baer predicts crude oil prices may drop to $60 a barrel amid geopolitical concerns. While higher supply from Gulf producers could stabilise prices, sustained low prices are unlikely. The impact on consumers may be limited due to taxes and refinery costs in India.

articles.title: Can an NRI be the sole trustee of an Indian private trust?
articles.summary: There is no prohibition under the Indian Trusts Act on appointing a non-resident Indian as a trustee of an Indian private trust. However, the appointment should be structured carefully, in the context of the rights available to beneficiaries

articles.title: Mizuho Markets Head Expects BOJ to Raise Rates Soon, More Often
articles.summary: Mizuho Financial Group Inc. expects the Bank of Japan to pick up the pace of interest-rate hikes, with the next one coming as soon as next month, as the weak yen and inflation prompt the central bank to act more quickly.

articles.title: Jubilant Ingrevia shares to be in focus on Wednesday as company to acquire 40% stake in EDMS firm
articles.summary: Jubilant Ingrevia's shares are expected to draw interest as it announced a 40% acquisition of Zettaone Technologies for ₹189.2 crore. This partnership aims to strengthen capabilities in the electronics and semiconductor sectors, enhancing long-term value creation.

articles.title: Atlanta Electricals secures ₹194 crore order for 12 high-capacity transformers
articles.summary: Atlanta Electricals has received a Letter of Intent from APTRANSCO for 12 units of 160 MVA transformers valued at ₹193.92 crore. The order enhances its presence in the power transmission market and showcases its manufacturing capabilities in critical infrastructure.

articles.title: Hindustan Copper shares rebound 20% in 15 sessions. What’s driving the rally?
articles.summary: Hindustan Copper's shares rose 20% over 15 sessions, aided by higher international copper prices. With significant ore reserves, the company is poised for growth, especially as domestic demand may double in the next decade amidst rising copper prices and expanding applications.

articles.title: US stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq futures down up to 1% amid surging oil and bond yields
articles.summary: US stock futures suggest a negative opening as technology stocks decline, amid rising bond yields and oil prices, raising inflation concerns. The S&P 500 is expected to post its third consecutive day of losses, with individual stocks like Nvidia falling sharply.

articles.title: Crude oil stays above $90 per barrel as West Asia war drags on
articles.summary: Persistent uncertainty around the US–Iran war and the Strait of Hormuz continued to underpin the geopolitical risk premium in oil prices, keeping investors wary of renewed inflationary pressures, experts said.

articles.title: ONGC clarifies report on OVL’s Venezuela operations, says framework talks underway
articles.summary: ONGC confirmed OVL's bid for U.S. approval to resume operations in Venezuela, where it has significant assets that could be developed further. While a prior report suggested a license was granted, ONGC noted no material price movement or financial impact yet has been assessed.
